description: Labeled chat requests for the Codiv OpenJev cloud/edge router. Labels say where a phone assistant should answer: local (small on-device model is enough) or remote (needs a large model). Labels were written before any model run and must not be changed to match model output. Run with scripts/run_decision_routing_eval.py.
